title: Cross-Module Product Contract Evolution
promptSingle: Implement the catalog package according to the docstrings and type annotations. Keep the Product contract consistent between catalog/models.py and catalog/service.py, reject duplicate product IDs, preserve input data, and run the visible tests.

roles.prompt: Implement ONLY catalog/models.py. Define the Product dataclass and validation helpers exactly as documented, preserving field names and types. Do not edit catalog/service.py.

Implement ONLY catalog/service.py against the Product contract in catalog/models.py. Implement add_product, total_value, and find_product with duplicate and missing-ID behavior from the docstrings. Do not edit catalog/models.py.

Review the cross-module Product contract in catalog/models.py and catalog/service.py. Make only compatibility fixes needed so the documented constructor, validation, and service behavior agree. Do not change public function names.

reconcilerPrompt: Reconcile the model, service, and contract-review changes into one coherent catalog API. Preserve the Product field contract, reject duplicate IDs, and run all visible tests before producing the final change.
